entities.name: François-Xavier Villain
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: François-Xavier Villain was a French politician who was a member of the National Assembly of France. He represented the Nord department, from 2002 to 2017 and was a member of Arise the Republic, a small Gaullist party led by Nicolas Dupont-Aignan. He was also mayor of Cambrai.
